slides.title: Tokens leave the JSON and enter the keychain
slides.lede: A SecretStore port, one adapter per OS, aval secrets exec, and a doctor --fix that migrates inline MCP tokens.
slides.note: The value is never printed, logged or backed up.

slides.title: A warning is not a fix

items.title: Plaintext
items.text: doctor --security detects inline tokens but they stay in ~/.claude.json and .mcp.json.

items.title: Copied around
items.text: Backups, pasted configs and issues carry the token.

items.title: Manual fix
items.text: Every machine needs the sh -c wrapper by hand.

items.title: CLI and migration
items.text: secrets set, get, list, rm, exec; doctor --fix with backup.
